                elif delta_y != 0:

                return [dx, dy]

            target_opponent = (ox, oy)

        delta_y = target_opponent[1] - me_y
        # Move towards opponent
        if abs(delta_x) > abs(delta_y):

        else:
            dy = int((delta_y)/abs(delta_y)) if delta_y != 0 else 0
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Priority 3: Expand territory if unclaimed or in own territory
    # Search adjacent cells for unclaimed or not in own territory

        if 0 <= ox < width and 0 <= oy < height:
            if territory and territory[oy][ox] != 1:
                dx = delta_x
                dy = delta_y
                return [dx, dy]
    
    # Default: stay put
    return [0, 0]
